Root cause is DNA-classifier low-family-confidence widen firing on top of Brain's already-good routing. Also P1: rug pin lands on book on rug (want polygon centroid); hover highlight too subtle; click-to-enlarge lightbox for shortlisted swatches.

rca_of_the_issue: Previous failure was the legacy Brain path returning no object_locked flag for app_ctx='flooring', so _find_catalogue_matches applied low-family-confidence family_alternatives widening and let Laminate catalogue records into a Tile floor retrieval pool. The fix adds object_locked=True for context-specific app_ctx values, including flooring, so Brain routing wins over DNA alt-family widening.
